en-US.description: Vovsoft Screen Reader combines customizable text-to-speech and screen magnification to help visually impaired users navigate their PC comfortably.
en-US.longDescription:
Vovsoft Screen Reader is a lightweight accessibility tool that reduces the barriers low vision, visual impairments, and eye conditions can create when using your PC. Universal access matters, which is why it is crucial to make software as accessible as possible, helping more people take advantage of what modern computers have to offer.

This easy-to-use desktop utility is designed specifically for blind or visually impaired individuals. By combining automated reading and magnification into one simple tool, it aims to help those with poor vision navigate their computer more comfortably and with less eyestrain.

The software tries to dynamically detect the text under your mouse cursor or your active keyboard focus—such as when navigating through applications using the Tab key—and reads it aloud. This helps make interacting with standard Windows applications easier. You have full control to choose between your locally installed speech engines and adjust the reading speed.

Alongside audio feedback, the application features a built-in magnifier. The software smoothly enlarges the exact portion of the screen around your mouse cursor, helping make small text and interface elements easier to see. You can also customize the magnification factor to match your specific visual needs.
